# Satat — Self-Hosted AI Coding Agent

Satat is a self-hosted, always-on AI coding agent that watches a GitHub backlog, picks up labeled issues, writes code, runs tests, and opens draft pull requests for human review. This wiki documents the v0.2 Kubernetes platform design, its architecture, workflows, deployment model, and extension points.
